HomeNote Privacy Policy

[Darak Studio](the "Company") complies with the Personal Information Protection Act of Korea and other applicable laws, and processes the personal information of users of the HomeNote app (the "Service") as described below.

Effective date: [○ ○, 2026]

This English version is a translation provided for convenience. If there is any conflict or inconsistency between the Korean and English versions, the Korean version prevails.

1. Personal information we process and how we collect it

CategoryItemsHow collected
Sign-up and sign-inEmail address (if provided), sign-in service identifierProvided by Apple, Google or Kakao when you sign in with them
Family member informationFamily name, display name (how you are called), roleEntered by users
Child (managed) profilesChild's name (display name), date of birth (optional)Entered directly by the guardian (parent)
Service usage recordsTracked items (title, interval, due date, expiry date, notes), shared lists, events (title, time, place, notes), completion recordsEntered by users
To-dos and anniversariesTo-dos (title, assignee, repeat, deadline, praise points) and completion records, anniversaries (name, solar/lunar date, first year, related member), birthdays derived from members' dates of birthEntered by users
Gift ledger (family occasions)Other party's name (display name), type of occasion, amount given or received, date, notes — visible only to members of the same familyEntered by users
Child care and allowanceChild's praise stickers and reasons, timetable (schedule), supplies lists, height and weight records, allowance records (amount and notes; no actual money moves), to-do pointsEntered by the guardian (admin)
Fixed expensesItem name and type, amount, payment day, whether paid by automatic transfer, person in charge, per-period payment status and amount actually paid (we do not collect account or card numbers)Entered by users
Home backgroundOne home background photo chosen by the user (stored at reduced size, visible only to that user)Entered by users (selected directly from the photo library)
TripsTrip name, place and period, daily route (place names and times), notes, trip photos chosen by the user (stored at reduced size; location data and other metadata in the photo are removed when the photo is re-savedEntered by users (selected directly from the photo library)
Family notes and quick alertsShort messages left for the family (200 characters), "We're out of it" alerts (item name, who raised it, who pressed +1, who bought it, time)Entered by users

Weather regionName of the city/county chosen by the family (we do not collect the phone's location). When checking the weather, only that region's representative coordinates are sent to Apple and Korea Environment Corporation; no user information is sentChosen by the admin
NotificationsDevice push notification token, device type (iOS/Android)Generated automatically when notifications are allowed
PaymentsProduct purchased, transaction number, purchase date and time, store typeProvided by the Apple App Store (the Company's server verifies the transaction through Apple's App Store Server API)

The Company does not collect location information, contacts (address book) or payment method information (such as card numbers). We store only the photos users choose themselves for trip records and the home background, and we do not access the entire photo library. Payments are processed by Apple (App Store). At purchase, a family identifier (random ID) is included with the Apple purchase information, and the Company's server verifies that transaction through Apple's App Store Server API and then stores a purchase record (transaction number, product, purchase date).

2. Purposes of processing

  • Identifying members, sign-in, and creating, inviting to and managing family groups
  • Providing Service features such as tracked items, lists, events, to-dos, anniversaries, gift ledger, fixed expenses, trips, family notes and quick alerts, and sharing them among family members
  • Sending advance notifications (push) of due dates and expiry dates
  • Managing the free trial period, verifying purchases of the full access pass and granting access, and restoring purchases
  • Responding to inquiries and preventing misuse

3. Retention period

  • Member information and Service usage records: destroyed without delay when you withdraw (delete your account)
  • Even if you delete your account, tracked items, lists and events you left in the family remain so that other family members can keep using them; only the author information is deleted.
  • If the last admin of a family deletes their account, the entire family (members and all records) is deleted with it (the app notifies you before deletion).
  • Push notification tokens: deleted on sign-out, account deletion or app removal (once token invalidation is confirmed)
  • Retention required by law: records of payment and supply of goods under the Act on the Consumer Protection in Electronic Commerce (5 years), etc.

4. Provision of personal information to third parties

The Company does not provide users' personal information to third parties. However, by the nature of the Service, display names, roles and records the family uses together are shared with members of the same family group.

5. Outsourcing of processing and transfer abroad

ProcessorOutsourced taskDestination countryItems transferredTiming and method of transfer
Supabase, Inc.Database, authentication and server operation[Republic of Korea (Seoul region) / United States]All items in Section 1Transmitted over the network as needed while using the Service

Retention period: until the outsourcing contract ends or the user withdraws. Users may refuse the transfer abroad, but in that case they cannot use the Service (sign-in, notifications, payments).

6. Personal information of children under 14

  • Children under 14 cannot sign up for the Service themselves, and there is no screen for creating a child account.
  • A guardian (parent) may directly register a child's name (display name) and date of birth (optional) in order to assign the child to family events, tracked items and to-dos and to remember their birthday. This information is visible only to members of the same family, and the guardian can edit or delete it at any time (All tab > Members).
  • In the child care features, the guardian may enter the child's praise stickers, timetable, supplies, height and weight, and allowance records. Only the guardian (admin) can write and edit these records, and members of the same family can view them. Allowance records can be viewed only by the guardian and the child themselves (account aged 14 or older).

7. Procedure and method of destruction

  • When account deletion is requested, member information on the server is deleted immediately, and related data is handled according to Section 3 above.
  • Electronic files are deleted in a way that cannot be recovered. Backup data is deleted progressively within [up to ○ days].

8. Users' rights and how to exercise them

Users may at any time request access to, correction, deletion or suspension of processing of their personal information.

  • In the app: All tab > Family (edit display name), Trips > Photos > Delete photo, All tab > Settings > Home background photo > Use default background, Family notes > Delete, All tab > Settings > Delete account
  • By email: [privacy@domain] — we will act without delay (within 10 days).
  • To stop receiving notifications: phone Settings > Notifications > HomeNote

9. Measures to ensure security

  • Encryption in transit (HTTPS) and social sign-in that does not store passwords
  • Access control per family (database row-level security policies that block access to other families' data)
  • Administrative keys kept only on the server; sign-in sessions on the device kept in encrypted storage (Keychain/Keystore)
  • Minimal access privileges and management of access logs

10. Automatic collection tools

The Service does not use tracking tools (such as cookies or advertising identifiers) for advertising or analytics.
